Re: Questions for Wednesday October 26 Panel on Closing Civic Space
[contact omitted] Cara Thanassi Friday, October 21, 2022 at 5:03:18 PM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [opaque block] [contact omitted] Íñigo Fernández
Cc: [contact omitted] Emma Buckhout, [contact omitted] Michael Camilleri
Hi Iñigo,
As noted below,there will not be press at the event and the event will notbe recorded, live-streamed or further
distributed.
While we don't haveaperfect sense of how many people willattend the panel, several hundred people have registered
for the forum so it should be a healthy audience size. You can find the current list of registrants
here: [link omitted]
Best,
Cara
On Fri, Oct 21, 2022 at 4:50 PM Íñigo Fernández 4 [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Thank you for the information, Cara! I really appreciate the heads up. Also, could you please assist me
with answers to the following logistical questions.
1. Audience size
2. Would there be press at the event?
3. Will the event be recorded, live-streamed, or further distributed
Thanks in avance,
İñigo Fernández Baptista (he/him/his)
Director | Public Policy for México, Central America, and the Caribbean

Conoce las últimas noticias de Meta
From: Cara Thanassi <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Friday, October 21, 2022 12:06 PM
To: Íñigo Fernández < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Cc: Emma Buckhout <[contact omitted]>; Michael Camilleri <[contact omitted]>
Subject: Questions for Wednesday October 26 Panel on Closing Civic Space
Dear Iñigo,
I hope this finds you well on a Friday. We look forward to seeing you in Honduras next week and very much appreciate
your participation on the Voices panel.
Please find below the questions that we have developed.
Michael may or may not get to all of them and others may arise, depending upon the flow of the
conversation and the time available.
As discussed, there will also be time set aside at the end for questions from the audience. The conversation will be in
Spanish and there will not be press nor will the event be streamed.
Please let us know if you need any additional information.

Best regards,
Cara
•
Across your platforms, how does Meta address instances where
state media and/or state proxies are producing or driving content that has the potential to or incites harassment
and violence against those they view as oppositional - for example, civic leaders and organizations, independent
ledia, and/or political candidates
an you provide examples of harmful content that has been taken down or individuals/groups that have be
de-platformed in Central America?
•
En sus plataformas ¿cómo aborda Meta los casos en los cuales
los medios estatales y/o los proxies están produciendo o generando contenido que potencian o pueden incitar
al acoso y la violencia en contra de aquellos que ven como opositores - por ejemplo líderes de la sociedad civil,
organizaciones cívicas, medios independientes
y/o candidatos políticos? ¿Puede brindarnos ejemplos de contenido dañino que ha sido eliminado o de
individuos/grupos que han sido retirados de la plataforma en Centroamérica?
•
A recent Guardian article focused on the Brazil elections highlights the challenges that Facebook and similar
platforms face in identifying and addressing disinformation. As we consider upcoming elections in Guatemala
and El Salvador, can you speak to criticisms that existing company policies and associated resources are not
adequate to address the problem? What more
can be done?
Un artículo reciente de The Guardian enfocado en las elecciones Brasileñas resaltó los desafíos que Facebook
y plataformas similares afrontan para identificar y dirigir la desinformación. En miras de las próximas
elecciones en Guatemala y El Salvador, ¿puede hablarnos sobre las críticas de políticas corporativas existentes
y recursos asociados que no son adecuados
para abordar el problema? ¿Qué más se puede hacer?
•
How does Meta partner with civil society to counter disinformation and combat
online hate? What can organizations do if they want to collaborate with Meta or simply flag offending content?
•
¿Cómo se asocia Meta con la sociedad civil para contrarrestar la desinformación
y combatir la difusión de contenido de odio en línea? ¿Qué pueden hacer las organizaciones si quieren
colaborar con Meta o simplemente señalar contenido ofensivo?
•
What more should the U.S. government and other donors be doing to protect, defend, and promote civic space?

¿Qué más debería hacer el gobierno de los Estados Unidos y otros donantes para proteger, defender y
promover
espacios cívicos?
Cara L. Thanassi
Democracy Specialist for Latin America and the Caribbean
USAID Bureau for Latin America and the Caribbean, Democracy and Human Rights Team
